verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documentation of admin-enforced org-wide policies such as required app lock, export restrictions, or master password strength requirements. The export doc only says users can export their own data, and the Events API only reports account activity to a SIEM. Neither enforces policy, so this applicable axis has no supporting evidence.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can enforce org-wide policies — require app lock, restrict export, mandate strong master credentials — across every member's app
